answer: New identities must cross a widening canyon: the first costs one hour of verifiable delay, the second four, the third sixteen, so a thousand fakes need years of serial compute no parallel farm can shortcut. A grove of established agents then vouches only for identities that survived the crossing, and each vouch carries a violet seal that fades within one epoch unless the newcomer completes real paid work. Cloning is therefore priced in unforgeable time plus a perishable endorsement that no bot farm can stockpile.
